basis: Step 4 synthetic fixtures on Windows 11, about 8 GB RAM, 12 logical processors. Limits are engineering starting points, not universal safe limits.

epub.rendering: one active chapter; no document scripts or automatic external resources

xlsx.parsing: worker; normalize unavailable formula caches; no recalculation

csv.parsing: worker row callbacks; no numeric coercion

enforcedInLab: 256 MiB declared expanded ZIP bytes, with lower test budget for expansion probe
requiredBeforeProduction: enforce input limits before allocating whole-file buffers
enforce actual decompressed-byte limits rather than trusting archive metadata
enforce image pixel, canvas, cell and row budgets
cancel parsing and dispose workers, images, canvases and object URLs
measure release timing and memory with all supporting assets loaded on demand
test caps against additional real authoring-tool documents and other supported browsers
